reason: Grade 4 thrombocytopenia >100 days poses imminent hemorrhagic risk; anemia worsens decompensation. Urgent platelet transfusion and coagulation assessment are mandatory. Vital sign instability would require immediate ICU-level monitoring.
evidences: Emergency Medicine: platelet transfusion threshold for severe thrombocytopenia
Critical Care: spontaneous hemorrhage risk in grade 4 thrombocytopenia
ACLS: hemodynamic support for anemia-related instability
